requirements.description: CRSP monthly stock returns, prices, and shares outstanding for the sample period (July 1965 to June 2010).
Point-in-time CRSP names history for shrcd, exchcd, and siccd filters (PIT-correct universe construction).
CRSP delisting returns for the Shumway (1997) delisting-bias correction (dlret, dlstcd, dlstdt).
CRSP-Compustat linking table (CCM) for joining stock returns to gvkey-level fundamentals.

Compustat annual fundamentals for EMP (employees), CAPX (capex), SPPE (sale of PPE), PPENT (net PPE), NI (net income), AT (total assets), fyear, datadate, fyr, sich, and December fiscal year-end filter.
Fama-French three-factor model: Mkt-RF, SMB, HML, RF (monthly). The paper uses the three-factor model in the asset-pricing tests (Tables 1 and 3 alphas).
Firm-level total factor productivity (TFP) from Tuzel & Imrohoroglu (2013), used in Table 2 (TFP_t, TFP_{t+1} rows). This is a proprietary academic measure, not a standard Compustat field.

blocking_issues.reason: Firm-level TFP from Tuzel & Imrohoroglu (2013) is not in the ClickHouse Compustat catalog. TFP is not a Compustat data item; the Belo-Lin-Bazdresch paper sources it from an external academic paper (Tuzel & Imrohoroglu 2013) whose data is typically distributed only to subscribers of that paper's online appendix.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Drop the T2.TFP_t and T2.TFP_{t+1} rows from the T2 metric list (already documented in tables_to_replicate.json#T2.notes). The remaining T2 cells (HN, IK, ROA, KM, Size at t and t+1) replicate fully from the available catalog; this preserves T2's value as a portfolio-characteristics validation table.
